roster_grade.headline: 11-3 and #1 in title odds. Shough is now on the bench, so sell him for Jeremiyah Love and get younger at RB
roster_grade.window_explanation: #1 composite title odds in Week 7: #1 by record (11-3), #1 in points for (1,001), #5 by roster value. That's a win-now team. Keep every producing starter and spend true surplus (Shough, Daniels, bench WRs, Kamara, picks) on the one soft spot: an aging RB room (need 0.4).

strengths.label: Best record and most points
strengths.detail: 11-3 with 1,001 points for. One game clear of Buck-ee's and Phil's (10-4), and 28 points ahead of dickcole2410 (973) for the PF lead.

strengths.label: Spare QB on the bench
strengths.detail: Mahomes and Nix are starting, with Shough (3,930) and Jalon Daniels on the bench. Superflex only starts two, so Shough and Daniels are both tradeable. QB need is 0.04.

strengths.label: Deep WR group
strengths.detail: Watson and Higgins are starting, with Parker Washington (4,105) and DeVonta Smith (2,973) on the bench and Stribling on IR. WR need is 0.0, so one bench WR can be moved.

strengths.label: Loveland plus extra picks
strengths.detail: Young TE1 in Loveland, Hockenson behind him, and an extra 2028 1st and 2027 2nd to deal from.

weaknesses.label: Aging RB room
weaknesses.detail: Henry (32), Javonte (26), Hubbard (27), and Kamara (31) are all Declining. RB need is 0.4, the only real need on the roster.

weaknesses.label: Hubbard is still running hot
weaknesses.detail: Carolina is scoring 29.2 a game against a 22.6 Vegas average (+6.6). His numbers are likely to cool, so now is the time to swap him for a younger RB.

weaknesses.label: Thin RB depth
weaknesses.detail: RJ Harvey (1,714) is in the lineup, and the Broncos are 2.9 a game under Vegas. One more RB injury and Kamara is starting.

roster_grade.most_urgent_action: Sell Tyler Shough while he's running hot (+3.3 vs Vegas) and sitting on your bench: Shough + Malik Washington for Jeremiyah Love (Undefeated In My Dreams, 1-13, weak at QB/RB). Values match exactly (5,226 for 5,226). Then swap Hubbard + 2027 2nd for Kyren Williams (You Hate Us, Long shot and selling; Rams 4.1 a game under Vegas). Keep Mahomes, Henry, Javonte, Nix, and the starting WRs.

QB.commentary: Mahomes and Nix start, with Shough and Daniels on the bench. That's four QBs for two slots. Shough is the sell-high chip, Daniels is a package piece.

RB.commentary: Henry, Javonte, Hubbard, and Harvey all start, but every vet is Declining and Hubbard is inflated by a hot offense. This is the position to upgrade (need 0.4).

WR.commentary: Watson and Higgins start, Parker Washington and DeVonta Smith are on the bench, Stribling is on IR. DeVonta Smith is the WR to move for an RB.

TE.commentary: Loveland is the long-term TE1 and Hockenson is starting in a flex. Need is just 0.04.

trade_priority_order: Shough + Malik Washington → Jeremiyah Love (Undefeated In My Dreams, 1-13, weak at QB/RB). Even on value, and Shough is your bench QB3.
Hubbard + 2027 2nd → Kyren Williams (You Hate Us, Long shot and selling). Sell high on Hubbard (+6.6), buy low on Kyren (-4.1).
DeVonta Smith → Omarion Hampton (Quarterback Factory, 3-11, weak at WR/RB). A bench WR for a young RB, bought low (Chargers -6.6).
Jalon Daniels + 2027 2nd + Josh Cameron + Tory Horton → Breece Hall (Bijan Mustard, 3-11)
All-in instead of Love: Shough + Javonte Williams + 2027 2nd + 2028 3rd → Bijan Robinson (Bijan Mustard)
Sell Kamara to Rolling Ball (8-6, weak at RB, buying) for a 2027 3rd
Hold Mahomes, Henry, Nix, Loveland, and the starting WRs. You're 11-3.

sell_now.reason: Benched behind Mahomes and Nix, worth 3,930, and New Orleans is scoring 3.3 a game over Vegas. His value is at its peak and he isn't scoring for you.
A starter, but 27, Declining, and inflated by Carolina scoring +6.6 a game over Vegas. Swapping him for a younger starting RB is an upgrade, not a sell.
On the bench behind Watson and Higgins, with Parker Washington also available. WR need is 0.0, so he's true surplus.
QB4 who will never start for you. Rebuilders like a rookie QB, so he works as a package piece.
31-year-old bench RB whose value only drops from here.

buy_now.reason: 1-13 and weak at QB and RB. Shough gives them a starting QB and Malik Washington a WR, for one rookie RB. Even on value.

buy_now.from_team: You Hate Us Cuz You Anus
buy_now.reason: 7-7 but a Long shot, flagged as selling, and weak at RB/WR/TE. The Rams are scoring 22.5 a game against a 26.6 Vegas average, so you're buying low.
3-11 and weak at WR. The Chargers are 6.6 a game under Vegas, the biggest buy-low on the board, and Hampton is on their bench.
3-11, and Hall is on their bench. Dart is on IR, so a young QB helps them.
buy_now.offer: Jalon Daniels + 2027 2nd + Josh Cameron + Tory Horton

buy_now.reason: The all-in, as an alternative to the Love deal (it also uses Shough). Mahomes, Henry, Nix, and Harvey all stay.

do_not_trade: Derrick Henry (producing starter on an 11-3 team)
Parker Washington (highest-value WR on the roster)
trade_strategy.pick_strategy: You're 11-3, so picks are currency. Use the two 2027 2nds and 3rds/4ths to close gaps on RB deals. Hold the extra 2028 1st and your own 2027 1st unless they land Bijan or Love outright.

outlook.projected_power_rank: #1 composite title odds (#1 record, #1 PF, #5 value). You're the top seed if the lineup holds.
outlook.three_year_outlook: Win now with the Mahomes/Loveland/WR core. Adding a young RB this season (Love, Kyren, Hampton, Hall, or Bijan) also covers 2027, when Henry and Javonte age out.
outlook.season_narrative: The Jabroni Beaters are 11-3 in Week 7: best record, most points (1,001), and #1 in title odds. Shough is now a bench QB at peak value, and five Long shot teams hold the RBs you want. Shough, Hubbard, DeVonta Smith, and Daniels can buy a younger RB room without weakening the lineup.
key_risks: Regression: Hubbard (+6.6) and Shough (+3.3) are on offenses scoring above their Vegas totals
An RB injury, since Harvey is already starting
Rolling Ball (8-6, weak at RB, buying) is competing with you for the same sellers' RBs
key_upside_factors: Landing Love, Kyren, Hampton, Hall, or Bijan turns RB into a strength
Watson (-2.1) and Harvey (-2.9) are on offenses under their Vegas totals, so expect a bounce
Stribling coming back from IR deepens WR, which makes DeVonta Smith easier to move

teams_to_watch.why: 10-4 contender, one game back. Closest in the standings, so a rival rather than a trade partner.
8-6 but second in points (973). Dangerous in the playoffs.
